newsitem.title: USA: Zytec Q1 net rises despite sales drop.
newsitem.headline: Zytec Q1 net rises despite sales drop.

text.p: Zytec Corp said Tuesday that improved margins helped the company report higher earnings in the first quarter ended March 30 even though sales declined.

The company said net income reached $2.6 million, or $0.26 a share, versus $2.1 million, or $0.21, in the same period last year. Sales in the period fell to $57.6 million from $61.1 million in the first quarter of 1996.

Zytec, which makes electronic power conversion equipment, said the sales trend points to strong sales in the second quarter. The company also expects to maintain margins at or near current levels going forward.
Zytec shares closed down 1/8 Tuesday at 13-1/2.
